style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#F9FAFB;strokeColor=#6B7280;spacing=8;rounded=1;arcSize=3;" value="<b>Rules of the parallel track</b> &nbsp; The project owner submits the documents of a gate on the day that the gate before it says Yes. The reviewer of the gate decides by the date in the box. If a reviewer says No, the owner revises and resubmits in 2 working days or less. The development does not stop for the gates.<br><b>Hard stops:</b> no production install (S4-01) before gate 6 says Yes; no production runs (S4-02) and no release sign-off (S4-06) before gate 7 says Yes. Before SEND_RECORDS goes on or the judge starts (after October), gates 3, 6 and 7 examine the change again." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="96" width="1280" x="370" y="395" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Rules of the parallel track The project owner submits the documents of a gate on the day that the gate before it says Yes. The reviewer of the gate decides by the date in the box. If a reviewer says No, the owner revises and resubmits in 2 working days or less. The development does not stop for the gates.
Hard stops: no production install (S4-01) before gate 6 says Yes; no production runs (S4-02) and no release sign-off (S4-06) before gate 7 says Yes. Before SEND_RECORDS goes on or the judge starts (after October), gates 3, 6 and 7 examine the change again.
